observations: Yellow metal cylinder shown in all three photos, propped on a blue plastic basin, orange wall background.
A black metal burner/stove-head assembly sits in the open top of the cylinder in every shot; no cylinder valve, knob, or regulator neck is visible.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show the brand text 'GASLAND' stamped near the base of the cylinder.

Photo 1 shows a different brand mark, 'ZEN GAZ', with a circular certification-style logo and an 'extremely flammable' diamond warning, in the same position where 'GASLAND' appears in the other two photos.
No visible manufacture date, hydrostatic test stamp, or weight/tare markings legible on the collar in any photo.
Surface shows rust speckling and grime on the shoulder and body in all photos.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OJO REAL ESTATE MANAGER' overlay all three images.

claims.evidence: No weight/tare stamp or capacity marking is legible in any photo; 'quality' is a subjective claim not demonstrated.

risks.proof: A single photo set of the actual cylinder from all angles, taken in one session, showing one consistent brand stamp throughout.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable identity / treat as highest-risk listing, not a confirmed single genuine cylinder

risks.risk: No valve or regulator fitting is visible; only a burner head sits in the open top, so it's unclear if the cylinder even has a working, intact valve.

risks.if_unproven: priced as not functional / valve missing or unverified

risks.risk: No hydrostatic test date or manufacture date stamp visible, which determines if the cylinder is legally safe to refill in Nigeria.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the collar stamp showing test date and manufacture date.

risks.risk: Surface rust could indicate internal corrosion or thinning metal, a safety issue for a pressurized vessel.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas and the overall body condition.

risks.risk: No leak/pressure test shown, so functional gas-tightness is unverified.
risks.proof: A video of the cylinder holding gas or a leak test with soapy water on fittings.

proof_requests: A full, consistent photo set of the one actual cylinder being sold, clearly showing a single brand stamp throughout.
Close-up of the cylinder's neck/valve with the burner head removed.
Close-up of the collar stamp showing manufacture date and hydrostatic test date.
A video or photo of a leak/pressure check.
response.reason: The three photos, presented as the same single cylinder, show two different brand stamps ('GASLAND' and 'ZEN GAZ') in the identical position, a strong sign of mismatched or reused stock images rather than one genuine item being sold.
